C1019.title: Fujitsu ProjectWEB Platform Suffers Unauthorized Access Leading to Data Breach
C1019.summary: Fujitsu reported that attackers successfully gained unauthorized access to its ProjectWEB platform and exfiltrated some customer data. The incident is a typical data breach caused by access control failure.
